# DwellFi

> This is the agent-friendly navigation document (llms.txt) for DwellFi's public content. DwellFi is an AI-powered platform that transforms fund administration and real-world asset tokenization for alternative investments. Combining Gen AI, Blockchain, and intelligent automation, DwellFi enables private equity, real estate, venture capital, and hedge funds to streamline operations with 25%+ efficiency gains, 75% faster fund migrations, and 80% reduction in manual reconciliation time.

Important notes:

- DwellFi provides AI-powered fund data platform solutions, not investment advisory or financial decision-making services
- The platform integrates AI agents that handle repetitive tasks while human teams focus on strategic value-add activities
- All AI-generated outputs should be reviewed and validated by qualified professionals before making final decisions
- DwellFi is SOC 2 Type 2 certified, demonstrating strict data security, privacy, and operational controls

## Main Website

- [Home](/index.html.md): AI + Human Collaboration for Private Markets - how DwellFi empowers teams with AI agents that enhance human expertise in fund operations

- [Meet the Team](/about/team.md): Leadership profiles including founders Kumar Ujjwal (CEO, 2X founder, First PM at Punchh $500M exit) and Deepak Sheoran (CTO, 15+ years at Citadel, Rubrik, Walmart Labs)
- [Platform Capabilities](/platform.md): Detailed overview of AI agents, fund data platform features, and complementary human-AI collaboration capabilities
- [Use Cases](/use-cases.md): Real-world applications including data reconciliation, document processing, complex NAV calculations, fee calculations, waterfall distributions, and error detection
- [Tokenization Platform](/dwellfi-tokenization/index.html.md): Blockchain-powered infrastructure for real-world asset tokenization including private equity funds, real estate, supply chain receivables, and credit markets
- [Contact](/contact.md): Sales, support contact information and office location for DwellFi inquiries

## AI Agents & Capabilities

- [AI Agent Capabilities](/platform.md): How AI agents excel at data reconciliation (matching thousands of records with perfect accuracy), document processing (extracting structured data without fatigue), complex calculations (NAV, fees, waterfall distributions), error detection (identifying anomalies before they impact operations), and consistent execution (maintaining detailed audit trails)
- [Human Team Strengths](/platform.md): Areas where human expertise excels including client relationships, strategic decisions, regulatory judgment, exception handling, and process innovation
- [Before & After DwellFi](/platform.md): Transformation from teams buried in manual operations with high error rates to AI-handled tedious tasks with automated validation and scalable operations without adding staff

## Performance Metrics

- [25%+ Efficiency Gains](/company.md): Real operational improvements clients experience within weeks of implementation across fund administration workflows
- [75% Faster Fund Migrations](/company.md): Transformation of weeks of manual fund conversion into days of automated processing using AI-powered migration tools
- [80% Less Reconciliation Time](/company.md): AI-automated matching processes that free teams to focus on exceptions and strategic activities rather than manual reconciliation
